# Morph keys of morph4.pmx (lane 1 eye, lane 2 lip): select, set the weight,
# register, copy and paste, morph frame lines, and the VMD and PMM saves.
# morph4.pmx has no eyebrow (lane 0) or other (lane 3) morph, so the register
# buttons of those lanes only clear the key selection.
load model morph4.pmx
select morph 1 まばたき
select morph 2 あ
frame 0
morph 1 0.25
register morph 1
frame 12
morph 1 1
register morph 1
morph 2 0.5
register morph 2
frame 24
morph 2 0
register morph 2
register morph 0
register morph 3
save pmm registered.pmm
select all morph
save vmd registered.vmd

select all morph
copy
frame 50
paste
save pmm pasted.pmm

frame 6
line insert morph
save pmm line-inserted.pmm
frame 1
line delete morph
save pmm line-deleted.pmm

select all morph
frame 51
delete
select all morph
select all display
save vmd morphs.vmd
save pmm morphs.pmm
